queries.sql: SELECT `lab_orders`.*, `lab_orders`.`id` AS `order_id`, IFNULL(patients.patient_id_code, "N/A") AS patient_id, IFNULL(CONCAT_WS(" ", `patients`.`first_name`, patients.last_name), "N/A") AS patient_name, IFNULL(patients.phone_number, "N/A") AS phone_number, IFNULL(CONCAT_WS(" ", `doctors`.`first_name`, doctors.last_name), "N/A") AS doctor_name FROM `lab_orders` LEFT JOIN `patients` ON `patients`.`id` = `lab_orders`.`patient_id` LEFT JOIN `doctors` ON `doctors`.`id` = `patients`.`referred_to_doctor_id`
